summary: {caseworker} routes a misleading hearing-aid advertisement to the office responsible for advertising claims.
realLife: GAO reported that the FTC handles most device advertising claims and that FDA and FTC officials share hearing-aid concerns when needed.
inGame: needs: advertising complaints and device reports.

turns.pulledBy: The complaint includes a copy of the advertisement.
turns.what: A caseworker preserves the ad and the name of the seller.
turns.writesBack: The referral can identify the claim the buyer saw.

turns.pulledBy: The buyer also reports a device malfunction.
turns.what: The buyer describes both the sales pitch and a fault in the device.
turns.writesBack: Staff records a separate product concern for the device regulator.
